title: AXP Metadata
description: Agentic Experience Protocol (AXP) metadata. AXP extends UCP with product data, quality signals, and embedded experiences. Uses the same security patterns as UCP (ES256 signatures, JWK keys, detached JWS).

version.description: AXP protocol version in YYYY-MM-DD format (same format as UCP).

services.description: Service definitions keyed by reverse-domain service name (compatible with UCP services).

discovery_profile.title: AXP Discovery Profile
discovery_profile.description: AXP metadata for discovery. Can be included in /.well-known/ucp as an extension or standalone at /.well-known/axp.

capabilities.description: Supported AXP capabilities. Each capability extends dev.ucp base capabilities.

merchant_trust.description: Trust and reputation information about the merchant.

response_product.title: AXP Product Response
response_product.description: AXP metadata for product data responses. Compatible with UCP response format.

response_quality.title: AXP Quality Response
response_quality.description: AXP metadata for quality data responses (reviews, returns, trust).

response_experience.title: AXP Experience Response
response_experience.description: AXP metadata for embedded experience responses.

sandbox_policy.description: Security policy for the embedded experience.

signed_response.title: Signed AXP Response
signed_response.description: Wrapper for signed AXP responses using the same signature format as UCP.

signature.description: Detached JWS signature (header..signature format) per RFC 7797, same as UCP Request-Signature.
